pages.text: Leader of the FS Big Three. Periodically announces a $(bold)Disciplinary Inspection$(reset) (forbidding melee, ranged, jumping, shields, potions, or eating) for 8 seconds.$(br2)Breaking rules or excessive aggression builds $(bold)Demerits$(reset), increasing damage dealt by Rei and Ikuko and triggering confinement sanctions at max stacks.
Signature skills: Iron Fist, Judgement Bell, Confinement Order, School-Wide Verdict. Drops $(item)Tohka's Badge$(reset).
